card.name: The word open in open-label studies
card.fires_on: The word "open" (or the comma just before it) in the phrase "open-label", after study-design words like randomized, long-term, or uncontrolled. It predicts that a study or trial noun is coming.

modes.label: open after design adjectives
modes.description: "open" in "open-label" following words like randomized or long-term, before study or trial.

modes.label: comma before open-label
modes.description: A comma after "uncontrolled, open-label" or similar lists of study descriptors, where the next words describe the study.
modes.example: uncontrolled, open-label<<,>> longer-term bipolar depression study, patients who

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like trials, pilot, and study that complete a study description.
card.plain: It spots the start of "open-label" in a description of a clinical study, just before the word study or trial.
